title: Sparkly sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='riceGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8e0d0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='fillingGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc3333'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer nori (seaweed) - deep but lit green -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='30' fill='#1a5c3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='28' fill='#226b45'/>

  <!-- rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='24' fill='url(#riceGrad)'/>

  <!-- rice texture dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='55' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='64' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='64' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='#f5f0e5'/>

  <!-- filling: salmon/cucumber center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='12' fill='url(#fillingGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='9' fill='#ff8888'/>
  <!-- cucumber ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='6' fill='#4cbb6c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#8de8a8'/>

  <!-- nori shine highlight -->
  <path d='M 28 38 Q 32 30 44 28' stroke='#2e8a5a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- top-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(18,20)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  </g>
  <!-- top-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(82,18)'>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.2,-1.2 5,0 1.2,1.2 0,5 -1.2,1.2 -5,0 -1.2,-1.2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  </g>
  <!-- bottom-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(14,78)'>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.2,-1.2 5,0 1.2,1.2 0,5 -1.2,1.2 -5,0 -1.2,-1.2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  </g>
  <!-- bottom-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(86,80)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small sparkles -->
  <g transform='translate(30,12)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(74,10)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(10,58)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(90,58)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny star dots -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='1.2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='1.2' fill='#ffe680'/>
</svg>
